source_review.notes: Checked current official Apache Hadoop MapReduce tutorial, Mapper, Reducer, ChainMapper, MultipleInputs, and TotalOrderPartitioner documentation; the original Google MapReduce paper; and current Apache Beam model, Combine, and execution-model documentation. All ten URLs returned HTTP 200 on the retrieval date. Sources support per-record/keyed boundaries, combiner lifting, joins/order mechanisms, shuffle, retry, and accumulator claims.

evidence: Reviewed partition multisets, per-record transforms, accumulator lift/merge/identity/finish, join-side groups, side-input snapshot, raw and optimized record/byte measures, reduction fractions, hot-key set, source snapshot, and job identity.
Checked record, split, local accumulator, side input, complete key group, reducer partition, stage, and committed output remain distinct.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Mathematical merge laws are explicitly paired with representation policies for overflow, rounding, NaN, and tie-breaking.

evidence: Executed map-side-partial-sum with Python 3.14.4 and reproduced seven raw pairs, five local partials, and two saved pairs.
Reproduced mapper partials a:5/b:1 and a:4/b:6/c:8, with final a:9/b:7/c:8.
Recomputed the 200-MiB by 4,000-worker broadcast exposure as 800,000 MiB and the 6-GiB by 2,000-worker dimension exposure as about 12,000 GiB before sharing/compression.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Copy exposure is not claimed as exact resident physical memory because caching, sharing, serialization, and attempts differ.

evidence: Checked local pushdown under partition multiset union and accumulator correctness through lift, associative/commutative merge, identity, closure, and finish.
Verified mean needs sum/count and reviewed mergeable count/mean/M2 population-variance state.
Reviewed many-to-many join multiplicity, local/global top-k candidate argument, and record/byte reduction fractions.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Holistic exact operations and correlated or order-sensitive representations are not mislabeled as fixed-size mergeable summaries.

evidence: Reviewed empty/single/duplicate/null/NaN values, overflow, tie scores, unique-per-map keys, accumulator eviction, output expansion, and unbounded local distinct.
Reviewed left/right/full/semi/anti join semantics, nonunique dimensions, missing sides, hot many-to-many keys, mismatched partition/count/order/snapshot, and stale broadcast state.
Reviewed side-input memory/cache/digest failure, mapper/reducer retry, speculation, spill, object output, tenant mixing, sensitive caches/logs, and approximate-error boundaries.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Filter/projection, aggregate, join, distinct, order, retry, and governance boundaries are all exercised.

evidence: Traced immutable input and side-input versions through safe early fields/predicates, mergeable partials, compatible key encoding, shuffle grouping, and committed output.
Checked map-side joins require bounded replicated data or exact co-partition/sort/snapshot compatibility.
Checked attempts isolate local state and external effects remain idempotent or commit-mediated.

evidence: Reviewed the ten-step audit from snapshot pinning and information dependencies through pushdown, accumulator laws, join choice, bounds, staging, attempt isolation, equivalence, and total cost.

Checked counterexamples for map-side-is-always-faster, arbitrary pushdown, scalar average, guaranteed combiner, broadcast-loaded-once, mutable-API side input, folder-name co-partitioning, bloom exactness, and shuffle-bytes-only optimization.
Reviewed left-outer predicate placement and local-top-k proofs plus infeasibility of eliminating intrinsic Cartesian output through salting.

Confirmed the executable fixture is labeled as a local algebra model rather than a combiner invocation or failure simulation.

evidence: Reviewed raw/combined records and bytes, mapper CPU/memory/spills, broadcast distribution/cache, join multiplicity/skew, reducer groups, task/speculation, committed output, and end-to-end latency/cost evidence.
Confirmed no universal broadcast threshold, accumulator benefit, skew threshold, reducer memory, sketch accuracy, regulatory approval, or external-review claim is made.

Internal practitioner-oriented review only.
